components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact affirmative action using the principal interactive color.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font: 600 13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent-blue, #4a9eff); color: var(--button-primary-text, #07131f); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-blue-hover, #72b3ff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-gold, #f0c040); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Compact supporting action with a visible full border.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font: 600 13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--bg-box-header, #2a3f55); color: var(--text-primary, #e8edf2); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3f55); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, #2a4060); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-blue, #4a9eff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Global collection search with compact padding and explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-search { min-width: 240px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3f55); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-box, #1e2d3d); color: var(--text-primary, #e8edf2); font: 400 0.9rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #9aa9b8); } .ds-search:hover, .ds-search:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent-blue, #4a9eff); }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: Primary route tab with a filled active state.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Primary"><button class="ds-tab">Boxes</button><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active">Builds</button><button class="ds-tab">Teams</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tab { padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3f55); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-box, #1e2d3d); color: var(--text-secondary, #8899aa); font: 700 0.85rem/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, #2a4060); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-gold, #f0c040); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--accent-blue, #4a9eff); border-color: var(--accent-blue, #4a9eff); color: var(--button-primary-text, #07131f); }

components.name: Type Badge
components.description: Short semantic badge using committed Pokémon type color.
components.css: .ds-type-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--type-water, #6390f0); color: #fff; font: 600 11px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Storage Box
components.html: Box 01
components.css: .ds-box { width: 290px; overflow: visible; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3f55); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg-box, #1e2d3d); color: var(--text-primary, #e8edf2); } .ds-box-header { padding: 4px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3f55); border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0; background: var(--bg-box-header, #2a3f55); color: var(--accent-gold, #f0c040); font: 600 0.75rem/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: center; } .ds-box-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 44px); gap: 2px; justify-content: center; padding: 4px 8px 8px; } .ds-slot { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #8899aa); cursor: pointer; font: 600 10px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-slot:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, #2a4060); } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-blue, #4a9eff); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Filter Toolbar
components.description: Dense filter grouping that keeps labels and controls scannable.
components.html: View
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--text-secondary, #8899aa); } .ds-toolbar-label { margin-right: 4px; color: var(--text-muted, #9aa9b8); font: 600 0.72rem/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-toolbar-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font: 400 0.85rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toolbar-check input { accent-color: var(--accent-blue, #4a9eff); } .ds-toolbar-select { padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3f55); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-secondary, #162231); color: var(--text-primary, #e8edf2); font: 400 0.82rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toolbar-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-gold, #f0c040); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(480px, 100%); padding: 20px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3f55); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg-box, #1e2d3d); color: var(--text-primary, #e8edf2); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-dialog button { padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3f55); border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-cancel { background: var(--bg-box-header, #2a3f55); color: var(--text-primary, #e8edf2); } .ds-dialog-danger { background: var(--accent-red, #f87171); color: var(--button-danger-text, #210909); } .ds-dialog button:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-gold, #f0c040); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The interface is a modern collection workstation viewed through the memory of a Pokémon storage terminal. It is focused, nostalgic, and precise: Pokémon sprites and box positions lead, while the application chrome stays compact enough to disappear into the workflow. The default theme is a dark PokéPC workspace for sustained scanning. The optional Gen III theme is an authentic alternate skin built from FireRed and LeafGreen-era colors, pixel typography, hard frames, and instant interactions. Both themes preserve the same information hierarchy and component behavior. The system explicitly rejects the feel of a sterile enterprise administration tool.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, spatial collection views with Pokémon as the dominant visual material.
Compact controls whose active, hover, selected, and invalid states are unmistakable.
Flat-at-rest surfaces; elevation appears only when content genuinely changes layer.
Semantic color channels for ownership, readiness, warnings, games, types, and stats.
A responsive shell that preserves scanning and editing workflows on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Semantic Channel Rule
rules.body: Blue means interaction, gold means completion, green means ready or correct, and red means danger or mismatch. Never reuse these colors as arbitrary decoration.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: A theme may change material, typography, and rendering style; it must never change the meaning or visibility of a state.

rules.name: The Sprite-First Rule
rules.body: Type must identify and explain Pokémon; it must not compete with sprites through oversized display treatment.

rules.name: The Pixel Legibility Rule
rules.body: Never render VT323 below 16px, and never use Press Start 2P for paragraphs, dense tables, or long control labels.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Repeated collection content is never raised merely to look clickable. Elevation signals layering, not decoration.

dos: Do keep Pokémon sprites, forms, box positions, Builds, and Teams visually dominant.
Do preserve the shared semantic color meanings across both themes.
Do use full borders, tonal surfaces, and spacing before adding elevation.
Do keep controls compact and unmistakable, with explicit active and focus states.
Do keep unknown, mismatched, and blocked states visibly distinct from confirmed states.
Do preserve mobile wrapping and touch-target behavior whenever dense desktop controls change.
donts: Don't make the product resemble a sterile enterprise administration tool.
Don't introduce generic corporate dashboard cards, oversized KPI treatments, or detached business terminology.
Don't raise every box, row, or card with a shadow; collection surfaces are flat at rest.
Don't use blue, gold, green, or red as arbitrary decoration that weakens their semantic roles.
Don't add nostalgia that slows scanning, hides data, or replaces familiar controls with game imitation.
Don't let an unknown form, placement, or training state appear confirmed.
